Name: FlipSide
Overview:
Flip and slide your way to action puzzle bliss. Whether you want relaxed-but-tricky puzzles, computer opponents or endless tiles raining down - Flippin' has you covered!
Flippin' uses a board made of double sided tiles. You can flip a tile so what was on your side is now on the far side and vice versa. Flip pieces to get 3 like symbols on your side horizontally or vertically and they will go away and give you points. How big of a match can you make? Pieces then fall quickly down and you can use them to make a combo to multiply your score. There's even a tutorial mode that quickly teaches you the rules as you play.
The best puzzle game you'll play this year on the iPhone or anywhere! Highly addictive, great looking, finely-tuned gameplay, 5 fun characters to chose from each with their own unique catch phrases and great sounds to boot. A steal at double the price.
